normal: Use exact specified asset and label rect.

pressed.note: Static pressed state specified as rendering parameters, not a new raster. No layout shift or enlarged overlapping hitboxes.

focus.shape: Follow component rectangle with 18px radius, outside sprite canvas; do not obscure labels.
focus.policy: Keyboard focus only, not always-on mobile decoration.

disabled.semantic_reason: Provide explicit reason label/ad unavailable/not unlocked/loading; color is not only cue.

toggle: Music and sound independent, OFF artwork from STATIC_PAUSE_OFF_PRIORITY_v1; ON original remains.
safety: This is interaction art/state specification only, not audio, billing, ads or game logic implementation.
